question: Show Gastric/GEJ trials using PD1 where PD‑L1 positivity was an inclusion criterion.

llm.answer: Gastric/GEJ trials using PD1 where PD-L1 positivity was an inclusion criterion.
llm.assumptions: PD-L1 positivity inclusion criteria is assumed to be binary (Yes/No) and case-insensitive.
llm.raw:
